TAKE SOMETHING WITH YOU 
Make room 
for wonder. 
You do not need a distant horizon
to practice paying attention.
A familiar street in unfamiliar light
can be the start of something. 
01   Take the longer way home. 
02   Leave your headphones in your pocket. 
03   Learn the name of one tree. 
04   Sit still for five unhurried minutes. 
05   Write down what you notice. 
Begin again tomorrow.
